title: The operatic productions in the Netherlands database
descriptions: The Operatic productions in the Netherlands database gives an overview of over five thousand opera productions staged in the Netherlands between 1886-1995. It is a full digitization of the Annalen van de Nederlandse Opera-gezelschappen (The Annals of the Opera Companies in the Netherlands), that was published in 1996 by the Dutch Theatre Institute and Dutch National Opera.
